profile.visual_desc: Lean elf in dark blue tactical gear with a tan tabard. Equipped with a massive, corded shoulder cannon and tan headgear.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Stoic elf face with dark blue hair and a tan visor covering the eyes. Distinctive pointed ears are visible.
profile.weapon_desc: Large metallic energy cannon mounted on the right shoulder, braced by both hands.
profile.step1_ready: Frame 1: Stands in a rear-isometric view, holding the heavy cannon high on the shoulder.
profile.step2_windup: Frames 2-3: Lowers the weapon to a horizontal level, bracing the body for recoil.
profile.step3_impact: Frame 4: Discharges a continuous, horizontal golden energy beam projecting toward the top-left.
profile.step4_finish: Frames 5-6: Weapon remains leveled as the beam dissipates, then is hoisted back to a high shoulder carry.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The straight golden energy beam must align perfectly with the cannon's muzzle, extending linearly toward the upper-left.

evaluation.diagnosis: The animation sequence is an excellent expansion of the 6-frame original. It correctly replicates the wind-up from a high-shoulder carry to a leveled firing position (F0-F4). The beam VFX in F5-F7 is perfectly aligned with the muzzle, and the recoil/recovery frames (F8-F9) provide a smooth transition back to idle.
